panel.title: Import bank statement
panel.intro: Choose your bank, then upload the PDF you downloaded from it (up to 10 MB). Scanned statements and photos won’t work.
panel.notice: Save any row edits first. Only the expenses and deposits you select are added, and only after you confirm.

completion.title: Import complete

refreshFailed.cashIn: The import worked, but we couldn’t refresh your deposits in Transactions. Use that list’s refresh button to see them.
refreshFailed.both: The import worked, but we couldn’t refresh your expenses and deposits in Transactions. Use each list’s refresh button to see them.
refreshFailed.generic: The import worked, but we couldn’t refresh Transactions. Reload this page to see your imported transactions.
